note.pt: Implementação sugerida · marcas oficiais das tecnologias

scope: 24 architecture compositions across 48 final Portuguese and English SVGs. Sequence diagrams are documented separately.
interpretation: Technology marks identify proposed component implementations. They do not establish Nubank internal architecture, deployment, affiliation or endorsement. A null node technology is an intentionally technology-neutral role.
